source:
@@U00372@@
For the present, I bid you— no, I implore you— to give me my leave.

@@U00374@@
No, stay another moment, won't you? Tell me what other news you have.

@@U00376@@
Let me go for now. I'll come back soon. You can ask me then to your heart’s content.

@@U00378@@
You must admit, I didn’t trap you. You did it yourself. Once you've got the Devil in hand, never let go; it won't be so easy the second time around.

@@U00380@@
All right, then, if you like, I’m prepared to stay and keep you company; but only on one condition: you'll let me entertain you with my arts in some worthy fashion.

@@U00382@@
Vd like that. Yes. It’s up to you. As long as your arts are amusing.

@@U00384@@
Your senses, my friend, will know more stimulation in this hour than in a year of academic monotony. The songs these gentle spirits sing, the lovely images they bring, are no mere empty sorcery. Smell and taste and touch will be ravished with delight. No preparation needed, let us begin!
translation:
@@U00372@@
目前，我请你——不，我恳求你——让我离开。

@@U00374@@
不，再等一会儿，好吗？告诉我你还有什么消息。

@@U00376@@
暂时让我走吧。我很快就会回来。那么你可以随心所欲地问我。

@@U00378@@
你必须承认，我没有陷害你。你自己做的。一旦你抓住了魔鬼，就永远不要放手；第二次就不会那么容易了。

@@U00380@@
好吧，那么，如果你愿意的话，我准备留下来陪伴你；但只有一个条件：你会让我以某种有价值的方式用我的艺术来娱乐你。

@@U00382@@
Vd就这样。是的。由你决定。只要你的艺术有趣。

@@U00384@@
我的朋友，你的感官在这个小时会比在一年的单调学术中感受到更多的刺激。这些温柔的灵魂所唱的歌曲，他们带来的可爱的形象，不仅仅是空洞的巫术。嗅觉、味觉和触觉都会被愉悦所陶醉。无需任何准备，让我们开始吧！
